### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/platform-objects`, touching **292** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/index.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**66** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f6a429b95cc183a0c1b610bf185d396c3915244a`.

⛔ **19** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/index.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **2** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `sys_user (symbol, 49 pages)`, `snake_case (literal, 52 pages)`
- **33** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **64** of **227** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **163** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **163**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **104** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **3** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f6a429b95cc183a0c1b610bf185d396c3915244a` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `7cb5d079e24a2973112e87b52eb83e6273066c0d` — the merge of head `efe02a1756a3e095bfa458add5860f81776726ad` into base `f6a429b95cc183a0c1b610bf185d396c3915244a`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 7cb5d079e24a2973112e87b52eb83e6273066c0d && git checkout 7cb5d079e24a2973112e87b52eb83e6273066c0d
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin f6a429b95cc183a0c1b610bf185d396c3915244a efe02a1756a3e095bfa458add5860f81776726ad && git checkout -B drift-repro f6a429b95cc183a0c1b610bf185d396c3915244a && git merge --no-ff efe02a1756a3e095bfa458add5860f81776726ad

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f6a429b95cc183a0c1b610bf185d396c3915244a
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs f6a429b95cc183a0c1b610bf185d396c3915244a` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review — ACCEPT

Head-sha: `efe02a1756a3e095bfa458add5860f81776726ad`

**席位意见：ACCEPT · 默认档，席位自审 · 2026-11-08T10:43Z**。本 PR 不碰任何契约面：`Clause-②: no`、`Metadata-protocol: none`，没有 `packages/spec/src`，也没有 governed 文本。所以按 fr（#31233，6711753758）和 pt-BR（#31440，6719237445）的先例，由席位在默认档自审，不另起审查代理。PR 有 7328 行，超过 3000 行门槛，按 Tier H 走人工合并。

## 席位核对

- **形态：** draft，目标 `main`。首行 `Part of #30512`，后面还有 `de`、`ko` 两个语言没做。全文没有任何闭合关键词。正文带 `Thread-read: 6719477612`（ru 的认领评论）。
- **覆盖：** 38 个文件，与 #31440 逐文件对齐，包括 ru 的两份生成包、出处表、手写 Setup 包、摘要表、抽取配置、注册行、三处内嵌映射，以及 pt-BR 加过的各测试语言列表。ru 以外改动的非测试文件，只有注册、内嵌映射和 fr 那两行，其余 23 个生成文件没有出现在 diff 里。
- **fr 修正（同卡相邻缺陷，认领的文件面已包含）：** `fr.ts` 里 `pages.connect_agent.subtitle` 按当前 `en` 文案（"Work in this system from Claude, Doubao and other AI assistants. …"）重译，`fr.source-hashes.ts` 的摘要从 `b0d7c6d174511bcb` 改为 `51c467af44024a1b`。席位读了 diff，只改了这一条 fr 叶子。
- **抽读译文：** 席位按间隔读了 `ru.ts`：`Связанные учётные записи`、`Центр согласований`、`Настройки уведомлений`、`Веб-хуки`、`Консоль API`、`Обзор системы`、`Число организаций`。用词与现有 ru 插件包一致，没有直接照搬 `en` 的地方。45 处与 `en` 字节相同的叶子已在 Acceptance notes 里分类列出（标识符、头部名、JSON 示例）。
- **门禁（check-runs @ `efe02a17`）：** 35 个 success，13 个 skipped，0 个失败。dev 本地 `dispatch-gates --ran` 68/68 退出码 0，NOT-MEASURED 为 0；platform-objects 1841/1841 通过。合并 #31435 之后补译了两条 ru 叶子，重新抽取后 `check-i18n-bundles` 同步。
- **changeset：** `30512-platform-objects-ru.md`，给 `@objectstack/platform-objects` 记一个 patch，并写明了 fr 修正。
- **接受的偏差：** 没有 plugin-audit 的 ru 守护测试（pt-BR 那个守护测试不在本次认领的文件面里）。正文 Verification 引的是 `9c137f20` 时的门禁，但 `efe02a17` 只多了合并和两条 ru 叶子，上面的 check-runs 就是在 head 上读的。
- **兄弟 PR：** #30964 的 PR #31475 会给 `sys_audit_log` 加一个动作标签，所有语言都要重新生成。后合并的那个 PR 负责合 `origin/main` 并重新抽取。
- **落地条款：** 7328 行，需要 GOVERNED_APPROVERS（os-zhuang 或 hotlong）批准后才能进队。批准后，席位让卡线程再合一次 `origin/main`，重跑 `check:app-nav-i18n`、hub parity 和 `platform-page-i18n-parity`，然后由席位落地。
